description: For a first-order language \(L\), a finite set of free names, and finitely many protected bound slots, infinitary formulas use the shared finite terms, equality, relations, falsity, implication, universal quantification, and a countable sequence of conjuncts in one common finite context.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.Formula.{u, v, w} (L : FirstOrder.Language) (α : Type w) [Finite α] :
  ℕ → Type (max u v w)
